# LoRAverse

> LoRAverse: A Submodular Framework to Retrieve Diverse Adapters for Diffusion Models

LoRAverse is a research project accepted at ICCV 2025 that addresses the problem of
selecting relevant and diverse LoRA adapters from large-scale repositories (100K+ models)
for diffusion model personalization. It frames adapter selection as a combinatorial
optimization problem and proposes a submodular retrieval framework.

## Authors

- Mert Sonmezer (Middle East Technical University)
- Matthew Zheng (Virginia Tech)
- Pinar Yanardag (Virginia Tech)

## Resources

- Project page: https://loraverse-vt.github.io/
- Paper (PDF): https://arxiv.org/pdf/2510.15022
- arXiv abstract: https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.15022
- Code: https://github.com/mertsonmezer/LoRAverse

## Key Concepts

- LoRA (Low-rank Adaptation) adapters for diffusion models
- Submodular optimization for diverse subset selection
- Concept extraction and semantic clustering
- Safety-aware adapter filtering
- Evaluated on diversity metrics vs. Stylus and SD v1.5 baselines
